purpose: Post-hoc descriptive error-confidence and true-class score distribution diagnosis; original Outcome B unchanged

definitions.alpha_true: p if y=0 else 1-p; requires true label

empty_bin: retain; proportion, rate and mean NA

descriptive_quantiles.method: linear: h=(n-1)*q; interpolate adjacent order statistics; computed exactly from weighted unique-value groups; never refit threshold

bootstrap.invalid: exclude zero-denominator replicate per metric; report valid count
bootstrap.scope: overall per confidence bin and predicted subset; time segments descriptive; conditional on fixed frozen model

raw_risk_coverage.order: descending confidence, entire exact float64 ties included; Raw labels unchanged
raw_risk_coverage.selection: first whole tie-group boundary reaching/exceeding target
raw_risk_coverage.recall_denominators: all true Benign/Attack in same period (end-to-end correct acceptance); additional recall within accepted true class reported
raw_risk_coverage.purpose: post-hoc diagnostic, not deployment thresholds; no best point, AURC or significance test

score_plots.rendering: ECDF on fixed 2001-point x grid per displayed range plus observed calibration values and frozen thresholds; exact counts at each displayed x, steps are display compression; raw risk curves compressed to <=3000 whole-group boundaries plus requested target points, all numeric target results exact

processing: cache mmap; 10000-row window aggregation; bounded one-period probability workspace <=6,860,000 float64 entries filled in 100000-row chunks; retain unique-value grouped counts, never copy full cache; no per-flow output
restrictions: no sampling, fitting, threshold changes, probability transforms, new rules, other domains/models/methods, hashes, messages or subsequent experiments
